items.headline: Who could challenge Gianni Infantino for FIFA presidency?
items.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino faces mounting pressure to resign following his failed plan to sell World Cup rights to private equity investors. The world players' union accused him of abusing presidential power, while UEFA threatened potential legal action and possible World Cup boycotts. Multiple rivals, including Portugal legend Luís Figo, are circling to challenge Infantino's presidency.

items.headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Hits $700 Million at Domestic Box Office, One of Seven Movies to Ever Reach the Milestone
items.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day became the fastest film ever to reach $700 million at the domestic box office, breaking records with a $360 million opening weekend and cementing its status as this year's highest-grossing film.

items.headline: 6 Things You Need to Know About the Shocking $12.5 Billion Lakers Sale
items.summary: Venture capitalist Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger purchased the Los Angeles Lakers in a record-breaking $12.5 billion deal, marking the most expensive sports team sale in history.

items.headline: Alex Eala defeats Alycia Parks to barge into third round in Toronto
items.summary: Philippine tennis sensation Alex Eala defeated American Alycia Parks in Toronto to advance to the third round, avenging her Australian Open loss and continuing momentum after winning her biggest career title in Washington D.C.

items.headline: Lewis Hamilton determined to stop mistakes; Hungarian GP a race 'where championships are lost'
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton acknowledged he must eliminate recent costly mistakes as he faces a critical Hungarian Grand Prix, noting that such races are where championship hopes are ultimately won or lost by season's end. He received his fourth penalty in three rounds.

items.headline: ‘The Odyssey’ Sets 20,000 Screen China Release, Including Near-Total Imax Commitment (EXCLUSIVE)
items.summary: The Odyssey received a massive 20,000-screen China release with nearly complete IMAX commitment, signaling major distribution confidence for the film.

items.headline: Tyler Duckworth Dies: MTV’s ‘The Challenge’ Alum Was 44
items.summary: Tyler Duckworth, MTV reality star who appeared on The Real World: Key West and won two seasons of The Challenge, died at age 44. The entertainment community mourned the loss of the beloved competition series alum.

items.headline: Perez Hilton's Sister Gives Update on 'Long Road' to Recovery and His Kids
items.summary: Perez Hilton's sister Barbara provided an update on the celebrity blogger's recovery following his hospitalization, confirming he is on a long road to wellness while his children remain in their grandmother's care.

items.headline: Kylie Jenner, Nick Carter, Becky G and More!
items.summary: Entertainment figures Kylie Jenner, Nick Carter, and Becky G made headlines during this period with various celebrity moments and appearances.

items.headline: Enzo Maresca says captaincy ploy unlikely to work if Erling Haaland was leading Man City
items.summary: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca indicated that Erling Haaland is unlikely to receive the captain's armband due to his elite goalscoring abilities, discussing the practical challenges of captaincy for star strikers.

items.headline: McGonigle drives in three to lead Tigers past Guardians 6-4
items.summary: Kevin McGonigle drove in three runs while Drew Anderson pitched four strong innings as the Detroit Tigers defeated the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: DGA and IATSE Push Rob Bonta to Allow Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger With Conditions
items.summary: The Directors Guild of America and IATSE jointly urged California Attorney General Rob Bonta and Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison to urgently settle their antitrust lawsuit, citing concerns about prolonged uncertainty over the Warner Bros. merger.

items.headline: Halle Berry Goes Braless in Sheer Lace Cover Ahead of Milestone 60th Birthday
items.summary: Halle Berry celebrated her milestone 60th birthday by posting a braless photograph in sheer lace on Instagram, showcasing her ageless appearance and confidence.

items.headline: Don Nelson memorialized as NBA greats gather for Dallas service
items.summary: Don Nelson, the Hall of Fame coach and second-winningest in NBA history who won five championships as a player, died at age 86. NBA legends gathered in Dallas to honor his innovative coaching legacy.

items.headline: Diana Taurasi tales: Untold stories about retired WNBA legend
items.summary: Teammates shared untold stories and insights about Diana Taurasi following the WNBA legend's retirement, offering personal accounts from those who knew her best throughout her career.

items.headline: World Cup referee Anthony Taylor lands new role in Turkey
items.summary: English World Cup referee Anthony Taylor accepted a position as director of elite refereeing with the Turkish Football Federation, ending his 20-year career in English football.

items.headline: Why have Liverpool signed Barcelona captain Ronald Araújo, and what will he bring?
items.summary: Liverpool completed the signing of Barcelona captain Ronald Araújo on a season-long loan with a €55 million purchase option, adding versatile defensive depth to their squad.

items.headline: Hungarian Grand Prix: Lando Norris takes first victory of the season; Oscar Piastri retires from 2nd
items.summary: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix after his McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri collided with a backmarker while running second, while Lewis Hamilton lost further ground in his quest for a record eighth championship.

items.headline: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 Casts Emily Hampshire, Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, Sabrina Jalees, Priyanka
items.summary: The second season of Heated Rivalry cast Canadian actress Emily Hampshire alongside Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, and Sabrina Jalees, with highly anticipated production underway.

items.headline: Watch Ritchie Blackmore return to the stage with Deep Purple
items.summary: Legendary guitarist Ritchie Blackmore returned to the stage with Deep Purple after decades of estrangement, marking a long-awaited reunion that fans had given up hope of ever witnessing.

items.headline: They made a stoner comedy together. Kristen Stewart needs a joint to talk about how deep it is
items.summary: Director Dylan Meyer's feature debut, the absurdist stoner comedy The Wrong Girls starring Kristen Stewart and Alia Shawkat, achieves critical success with its unique comedic vision and ambitious scope.

items.headline: Jenna Ortega’s Sister Reacts to Public Discourse Over ‘Wednesday’ Star’s Appearance
items.summary: Jenna Ortega's sister publicly supported the Wednesday actress after social media discourse emerged regarding her weight loss, subtly defending her against unsolicited public commentary.

items.headline: 'Coyote Vs. Acme' Cost WB $70M, Ketchup Paid $50M For It
items.summary: Warner Bros. shelved Coyote vs. Acme cost the studio $70 million, with Ketchup paying $50 million for distribution rights before the unexpected reversal.

items.headline: Ryan Murphy reveals Jessica Lange’s 1 condition to return for ‘American Horror Story’ Season 13
items.summary: Jessica Lange negotiated one specific condition to return for American Horror Story Season 13, which producer Ryan Murphy accepted as he continues developing the acclaimed anthology series.

items.headline: Thomas homers to back Mahle in the Braves' 6-3 victory over the Mets
items.summary: Lane Thomas hit a home run and Tyler Mahle pitched six strong innings as the Atlanta Braves defeated the New York Mets 6-3 on Wednesday, with Thomas proving an impactful trade deadline acquisition.

items.headline: Travis Kelce calls MSG wedding with Taylor Swift 'best night of my life'
items.summary: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce called his MSG wedding with Taylor Swift the 'best night of my life' in his first public comments about the high-profile event.

items.headline: John Cena shares his unique take on WB shelving Coyote vs. Acme : ‘My answer’s not the common one’
items.summary: John Cena offered a levelheaded and unconventional perspective on Warner Bros.' decision to shelve and later release Coyote vs. Acme, distinguishing himself from typical industry reactions.

items.headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta welcomes speculation around Myles Lewis-Skelly
items.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta welcomed transfer speculation around young defender Myles Lewis-Skelly, expressing comfort with his players attracting interest from other clubs as a sign of quality.

items.headline: ‘Black Mirror’ Director Ally Pankiw Roasts ‘Harry Potter’ TV Series, Claiming She Turned Down Gig: “Say No To Funding Transphobia”
items.summary: Black Mirror director Ally Pankiw publicly rejected an offer to direct HBO's upcoming Harry Potter series, posting a screenshot of her refusal on Instagram while criticizing what she called funding of transphobia.

items.headline: Cover Story: The ‘Widow’s Bay’ Team Reveals Secrets, Stories & Season 2 Hopes
items.summary: The team behind Widow's Bay, the show earning 19 Emmy nominations, revealed behind-the-scenes secrets and expressed hopes for a second season, discussing the balance between New England charm and creeping dread.

items.headline: Jesse Eisenberg’s ‘The Debut’ & Fred Cavayé’s ‘Les Misérables’ Among Six New Titles In San Sebastián Official Selection
items.summary: Films by Jesse Eisenberg, Fred Cavayé, and Amanda Kernell, along with directorial debuts from emerging filmmakers, secured spots in the San Sebastián Film Festival's Official Selection.

items.headline: Matthew McConaughey Says Acting in ‘The Wedding Planner’ With Jennifer Lopez Saved Him From Being Searched at U.S.-Mexico Border: ‘They Let Me Go’
items.summary: Matthew McConaughey revealed on a podcast that appearing alongside Jennifer Lopez in The Wedding Planner (2001) unexpectedly saved him from a serious situation during a U.S.-Mexico border encounter.

items.headline: ‘Marvel’s Wolverine’ Video Game Team Goes Beyond The Claws To Unearth A More Vulnerable Logan
items.summary: Marvel's Wolverine video game from Insomniac Games takes a different creative direction than their Spider-Man series, exploring a more vulnerable and emotionally complex version of the character beyond just physical combat.

items.headline: ‘Warrior Cats’ Animated Series Debuts First Footage, Character Model at Tencent Video Event
items.summary: Tencent Video unveiled the first animation footage and character models for its Warrior Cats animated series at a Shenzhen fan event, with director Rodrigo Blaas presenting the adaptation of the bestselling book franchise.

items.headline: Remi Bader Tries on Skims' Micro Teddy: ‘Doesn't Even Fit My Nipple’
items.summary: Influencer Remi Bader gave a candid TikTok review of Kim Kardashian's Skims Micro Teddy, humorously noting that the tiny garment doesn't fit her, questioning the brand's 'Fits Everybody' marketing claim.

items.headline: DWTS' Julianne Hough Shows Off Bikini Body on Dreamy Sardinia Getaway
items.summary: Dancing with the Stars host Julianne Hough shared vacation highlights from a girls' getaway to Sardinia, Italy, showcasing her fitness and confidence in bikini photos.

items.headline: Jets' Qwan'tez Stiggers in concussion protocol after collapsing
items.summary: New York Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers collapsed during a joint practice against the Buccaneers and entered the NFL's concussion protocol after displaying symptoms, though coach Aaron Glenn said he is doing fine.

items.headline: Beau Hossler takes 1-shot lead at PGA Tour's Wyndham Champ.
items.summary: Beau Hossler shot a 3-under 67 with a birdie on his final hole to take a one-stroke lead at the PGA Tour's Wyndham Championship, while rookie Ben James made eagles on both par-5s.

items.headline: NHL rookie roundtable: Gavin McKenna and other top rookies answer burning questions
items.summary: NHL rookie Gavin McKenna, the top pick of the 2026 NHL Draft, outlined his season goals at the NHLPA Rookie Showcase as part of a roundtable discussion with other top prospects.

items.headline: What's next for MLS with Berg in charge as new commissioner?
items.summary: LAFC co-owner Larry Berg was named the next MLS commissioner, succeeding Don Garber starting next year, raising questions about his strategic priorities for growing the league.

items.headline: Max Verstappen 'still shocked' with podium finish at Hungarian GP after calling Red Bull 'broken'
items.summary: Max Verstappen expressed shock at securing a podium finish at the Hungarian Grand Prix despite spending the weekend battling his Red Bull's poor handling and describing the car as fundamentally 'broken.'

items.headline: Aces secure playoff spot with 83-76 victory over the Mystics
items.summary: Jackie Young scored a season-high 32 points with five three-pointers and A'ja Wilson added 15 as the Las Vegas Aces secured their playoff spot with an 83-76 victory over the Washington Mystics.

items.headline: Ureña pitches Angels past Rangers 7-0 as Trout and Guzman lead offense with 3 hits apiece
items.summary: Walbert Ureña allowed just two hits in six innings while Mike Trout and Denzer Guzman led a 15-hit offensive outburst as the Los Angeles Angels shut out the Texas Rangers 7-0.

items.headline: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston's skid to 5
items.summary: Kazuma Okamoto hit the go-ahead RBI single in a five-run eighth inning as the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Boston Red Sox 6-4, extending Boston's losing streak to five games.

items.headline: Logan Gilbert pitches 6 strong innings as Mariners stop 6-game skid with 1-0 win over Yankees
items.summary: Logan Gilbert pitched six strong innings on a four-hitter as the Seattle Mariners ended a six-game skid with a 1-0 shutout victory over the New York Yankees.

items.headline: Mike Trout leads offense and George Klassen earns 1st MLB win as Angels top Rangers 5-2
items.summary: Mike Trout went 3-for-4 with two RBIs and earned his first major league win in relief as George Klassen led the Los Angeles Angels' 5-2 comeback against the Texas Rangers.

items.headline: Tiffany Hayes comes off the bench to score a season-best 22 points as Valkyries beat Sky 91-71
items.summary: Tiffany Hayes scored a season-best 22 points off the bench with six rebounds and five assists as the Golden State Valkyries overcame a slow start to defeat the Chicago Sky 91-71.

items.headline: Noemie Brochant scores a season-high 24 as the Mercury beat the Sparks 94-87
items.summary: Rookie Noemie Brochant posted a season-high 24 points and Alyssa Thomas scored nine of her 16 in the fourth quarter as the Phoenix Mercury snapped a three-game losing streak with a 94-87 win over the Sparks.

items.headline: Montero, Tigers shut out Guardians without a strikeout, a first in MLB since 2014
items.summary: Keider Montero pitched three-hit ball into the seventh inning as the Detroit Tigers blanked the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 without recording a strikeout, the first such shutout in MLB since 2014.

items.headline: Alex Bregman's first career 3-homer game helps Cubs rout Nationals 12-6
items.summary: Alex Bregman hit three home runs in a game for the first time while driving in a career-high seven runs as the Chicago Cubs routed the Washington Nationals 12-6.
